description: Maps the PRD proof campaign (P0-P18) to the exact test that proves each case. A case with no test, or whose test does not exist, is reported as UNPROVEN rather than omitted.

cases.claim: An IMMEDIATE order uses the same routing, postcondition and receipt engine as a conditioned order, proving the engine independent of the timing trigger.
A conditioned order waits, becomes eligible under its recorded condition source, and fills.
A closed market leaves the order active and the capital unspent.
Pre-market is not the regular session and does not satisfy the trigger.
A stale condition observation never becomes eligibility, even when it reports REGULAR.
An UNKNOWN market state holds, and is distinguishable from a stale report.
The keeper cannot loosen the user's minimum output.
A route that under-delivers reverts rather than completing the order.
A second invocation cannot fill the same occurrence again.
A router that reenters execute() during the swap cannot produce a second fill.
A protected corporate-action window holds execution, then resumes automatically.
Partial router input consumption releases the unused capital and reports actual spend.
Partial-consumption accounting is exact across the full range of consumption ratios.
An expired order releases its reservation exactly once and can never fill.
A WHEN_AVAILABLE order on an unavailable asset stays active and reserved.
cases.note: Availability is enforced through the same registry SUPPORTED check; a paused asset exercises that path.

cases.claim: A terminal occurrence lazily creates the next one with its own reservation.
A ten-purchase plan reserves one purchase, not ten.
An underfunded next occurrence holds and resumes after top-up; the series is not silently cancelled.
A cancelled order can never execute.
An order requiring a stronger source tier than is available keeps waiting rather than downgrading.
An attestation signed by an unauthorized key reverts.
An unapproved router cannot spend vault funds.
An unapproved approval target cannot spend vault funds, checked independently of the router.
Route calldata cannot redirect the purchased asset away from the authorized receiver.
An asset with no proven X Layer deployment cannot be promoted to SUPPORTED.
Asset provenance holds against real chain state: symbols, decimals and wrapper.asset() round-trip.
Vault accounting holds against the real deployed X Layer USDC contract.

unprovenWithoutMainnet.claim: A provenance-backed availability transition makes a pending WHEN_AVAILABLE order eligible.
unprovenWithoutMainnet.status: mechanism proven by the registry SUPPORTED path; a live listing transition did not occur during the build window and must not be claimed as one.

unprovenWithoutMainnet.claim: A transaction that is included but whose delivery cannot be independently confirmed is reported as OUTCOME_UNKNOWN rather than success.
unprovenWithoutMainnet.status: implemented in services/worker/src/verifier.ts; requires a mainnet execution to exercise.

unprovenWithoutMainnet.claim: A tampered receipt fails independent verification.
unprovenWithoutMainnet.status: implemented in services/worker/src/cli-verify.ts (recomputes the content hash); requires a real receipt to exercise.

unprovenWithoutMainnet.claim: OKX DEX route compared against the strongest directly known X Layer route.
